concerns.text: T002 and T003 are tagged [P] and the dependency note says 'T001–T003 (parallel, independent files)', but their verification steps consume T001's output: T002's test validates 'a small real/synthetic pair from the processed Adult data' and T003's test runs 'one CTGAN fit for 2 epochs on down-sampled Adult' — both require data/processed/Adult/train.parquet from T001. The source files are independent but the tasks are not parallel-safe as specified; either drop [P] or make the tests self-contained fixtures.

The dependency note lists 'T007, T008 (after T006)' as if parallel, but T008 must write 'fraction_faithful' into outputs/summary/aggregated_metrics.csv, and the faithful classification (FR-020, including the power<0.8 exclusion that defines the tally) is computed in T007. T008 therefore consumes T007's output and must be sequenced after it (or the fraction_faithful computation moved).

T004 cites the contract at 'specs/001-evaluating-the-statistical-properties-of/contracts/metric_results.schema.yaml' while plan.md's project structure places it under 'specs/001-statistical-fidelity/contracts/'. Two conflicting paths for the same schema will confuse the T004→T006→T012 contract-test chain; pick one canonical path.
